metaDescription: Shopify store for AK Galleria, a Pakistani multi-brand fashion store: men, women and kids, brand filters, product search and installment checkout.
summary: Shopify store for a Pakistani multi-brand fashion retailer covering men, women and kids.
overview: AK Galleria sells fashion from many brands for men, women and kids, covering eastern and western clothing, footwear, accessories, beauty and personal care. We built AK Galleria's Shopify store as a multi-brand shop where the brand name matters as much as the category.
challenge: A multi-brand store has to work two ways at once: some shoppers come for a brand, others for a category such as jackets or sneakers. With deep menus for men, women and kids and frequent discounts, shoppers need fast search and filters that cut a large catalog down.
approach: A dark header pairs Sale, Pre-Winter Fashion, Men, Women, Kids, Brands and New Arrivals with a wide search bar for products, brands and more. Mega menus run from Pakistani contemporary wear to footwear, personal care and accessories. The home page adds a category circle carousel, gender tabs, a brand logo strip and product rows, and collection pages filter by brand, category, discount, gender, color and product type.
outcome: A fashion marketplace store where shoppers can start from a brand, a category or a search, and narrow results by brand and discount before opening a product.
deliverables: Mega menus for men, women and kids

process.title: Navigation
process.body: Mega menus for men, women and kids break the range into eastern wear, western wear, footwear, personal care and accessories, with a Brands menu and a search bar in the header.

process.title: Home page
process.body: A campaign slideshow leads into a category circle carousel, new fashion trends, men, women and kids tabs, a brand logo strip and accessories and beauty rows.

process.title: Collections
process.body: A filter sidebar for gender, color and product type sits beside dropdowns for brand, category and discount, with quick view on every product card.

process.title: Product pages
process.body: Product pages lead with the brand name, tax-inclusive price, BaadMay and Yeylo pay-in-three, size and color choices, add to bag, buy it now and a wishlist button.

whyItMatters: Multi-brand shoppers often know the label they want before the item. A store that treats brands as a first-class filter, next to category and discount, gets them to the right product faster.

faqs.q: What platform is the AK Galleria store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with a customized Dawn theme, using Shopify collections and filters for brands, categories and discounts, with Judge.me for reviews and BaadMay for installments.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build Shopify stores for multi-brand retailers, including mega menus, brand filters and installment payments. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
